tests.name: cbor_integer_array_positive
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization of large unsigned integer arrays using the optimized unbranched writer.

tests.name: cbor_integer_array_mixed_signs
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization of an array containing both positive and negative integers.

tests.name: msgpack_integer_array_positive
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of an array of various sizes of unsigned integers.

tests.name: msgpack_integer_array_negative
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of negative integers spanning all size classes (fixnum, int8, int16, int32, int64).

tests.name: vector_sink_large_string_append
tests.intent: Probes output_vector_sink geometric growth and direct append path for strings larger than max_reserve_size.

tests.name: vector_sink_large_binary_append
tests.intent: Probes output_vector_sink optimization when serializing binary blobs larger than max_reserve_size.

tests.name: vector_sink_destruction_trimming
tests.intent: Probes output_vector_sink destructor trimming vector size back to the exact written length.

tests.name: cbor_empty_array_and_object
tests.intent: Probes serialization of empty container structures using the refactored writer pathways.

tests.name: msgpack_empty_array_and_object
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of empty containers.

tests.name: cbor_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Probes deeply nested array structures to verify correct handling of recursion and sink positions.

tests.name: output_adapter_sink_stream
tests.intent: Probes the alternative output_adapter_sink path via stream serialization interface.

tests.name: cbor_boundary_integer_values
tests.intent: Probes CBOR encoding of integer boundaries (e.g., powers of 2 minus/plus one).

tests.name: msgpack_boundary_integer_values
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack encoding across all integer width boundaries.

tests.name: cbor_boolean_and_null
tests.intent: Probes serialization of booleans and null values alongside numbers.

tests.name: msgpack_boolean_and_null
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of non-numeric scalar primitives.

tests.name: cbor_floating_point_values
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization of floating-point numbers.

tests.name: msgpack_floating_point_values
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of floating-point numbers (float and double).

tests.name: cbor_mixed_type_object
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization of a rich object containing heterogeneous value types.

tests.name: msgpack_mixed_type_object
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of a heterogeneous JSON object.

tests.name: cbor_roundtrip_verification
tests.intent: Probes roundtrip consistency: serializing an array of numbers to CBOR and parsing it back.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises unbranched CBOR and MessagePack array serialization of integer arrays to trigger encode_cbor_integer, write_cbor_array, integer_size_class, encode_first_byte_and_tail, integer_bits, encode_cbor_integer_head, write_array_elements, write_cbor_integer, msgpack_integers_fit_64_bits, write_msgpack_integer, encode_msgpack_integer, write_msgpack_array, and write_msgpack_array_elements.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises output_vector_sink direct initialization, geometric growth, move construction, and destructor trimming by serializing a mixed structure into a vector.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises output_vector_sink large-scale append path (> max_reserve_size) to ensure append(), resize(), and vector reserve() are invoked properly.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises output_adapter_sink reserve() and commit() methods via stream operator serialization to std::vector.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises negative integer handling and width boundaries across the unbranched MessagePack and CBOR integer encoding routines.
